context: M21 o5. (Nick.) The Iron Gate. Lisle checks his watch. Nick orders another course.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Howard, sit. The cheesecake here is a legal document. Binding.

lines.speaker: char.howard_lisle
lines.text: Nicholas, I have a briefcase waiting. And principles about dessert.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Principles. Let me tell you about my first shop. Under a table. Nineteen forty-nine…

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Then I'll tell it better. Waiter! Two coffees. Greek. It takes a long time.
